description.narrative: Mozambique - Program Administration and Control - Environmental Management - MICOA Capacity Building activity: Through this Compact MCC has the option of providing a capacity building grant to the Ministry of Coordination on Environment ("MICOA") to facilitate their ability to respond to the increased workload arising from the Government's implementation of this Compact. This assistance would enhance MICOA's ability to, inter alia, adequately review all Compact-related environmental studies; issue environmental permits on a timely basis as provided in Mozambique environmental law and regulations; and hire, train and appropriately resource additional staff, as needed, in the provincial offices to carry-out effective environmental oversight and auditing of the implementation of Compact Projects.
